title: Hazard Pay-Plan Fee in the Projected Annual Hazard Premium
content:
A hazard insurance policy paid in installments costs the Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve under Set-Aside Accounts a pay-plan fee, which is added once to the projected annual hazard premium.

**Rule.** The hazard bills of the review are the hazard insurance bills on file for the reserve received within the twelve months before the review (no later than the review date and fewer than 12 whole calendar months before it). The hazard pay-plan fee is:

- the quarterly pay-plan fee, 32.00, where four or more of the hazard bills of the review are paid or received;
- the semiannual pay-plan fee, 12.00, where two or three are;
- otherwise zero.

The fee is added a single time, whatever the number of installments.

| Paid or received hazard bills of the review | Pay-plan fee |
|---|---|
| 0 or 1 | 0.00 |
| 2 | 12.00 |
| 3 | 12.00 |
| 4 or more | 32.00 |

Withdrawn hazard bills do not count toward the number.
